trades.bbr_text: The Charlotte Bobcats traded a 2004 1st round draft pick (Shaun Livingston was later selected) and a 2004 2nd round draft pick (Lionel Chalmers was later selected) to the Los Angeles Clippers for a 2004 1st round draft pick (Emeka Okafor was later selected). Charlotte also agreed to select Predrag Drobnjak in the expansion draft.
The Phoenix Suns traded a 2005 1st round draft pick (Sean May was later selected) to the Charlotte Bobcats. Charlotte agreed to select Jahidi White in the expansion draft.
The Charlotte Bobcats traded Zaza Pachulia to the Milwaukee Bucks for a 2004 2nd round draft pick (Bernard Robinson was later selected).
The Charlotte Bobcats traded Sasha Pavlović to the Cleveland Cavaliers for a 2007 1st round draft pick (Jared Dudley was later selected).
The Atlanta Hawks traded Viktor Sanikidze to the San Antonio Spurs for cash and a 2005 2nd round draft pick (Cenk Akyol was later selected).
The Dallas Mavericks traded a 2005 1st round draft pick (Linas Kleiza was later selected) to the Utah Jazz for Pavel Podkolzin.
The Denver Nuggets traded Jameer Nelson to the Orlando Magic for a 2005 1st round draft pick (Julius Hodge was later selected).
The Chicago Bulls traded Jackson Vroman and a 2005 1st round draft pick (Nate Robinson was later selected) to the Phoenix Suns for Luol Deng.
The Dallas Mavericks traded Vassilis Spanoulis to the Houston Rockets for Luis Flores.
The Dallas Mavericks traded Antawn Jamison to the Washington Wizards for Devin Harris, Christian Laettner and Jerry Stackhouse.
The New Jersey Nets traded Viktor Khryapa to the Portland Trail Blazers for Eddie Gill.
The Memphis Grizzlies traded a 2005 2nd round draft pick (Mickaël Gelabale was later selected) to the Seattle SuperSonics for Andre Emmett.
The Orlando Magic sold the player rights to Antonio Burks to the Memphis Grizzlies.
The Miami Heat traded Pape Sow and a 2005 2nd round draft pick (Uroš Slokar was later selected) to the Toronto Raptors for Albert Miralles.
notes: Real Miami draft-night transaction (draft rights).

trades.bbr_text: The Houston Rockets traded Kelvin Cato, Steve Francis and Cuttino Mobley to the Orlando Magic for Reece Gaines, Juwan Howard, Tyronn Lue and Tracy McGrady.

The Los Angeles Lakers traded Shaquille O'Neal to the Miami Heat for Caron Butler, Brian Grant, Lamar Odom, a 2006 1st round draft pick (Jordan Farmar was later selected) and a 2007 2nd round draft pick (Renaldas Seibutis was later selected).
notes: Real Miami transaction; skipped by world rule 1 (see library/2004/league/nba_2004_miami_transactions.json).

trades.bbr_text: The Charlotte Bobcats traded a 2005 2nd round draft pick (Daniel Ewing was later selected) and a 2006 2nd round draft pick (Paul Davis was later selected) to the Los Angeles Clippers for Melvin Ely and Eddie House.
The Atlanta Hawks traded Stephen Jackson to the Indiana Pacers for Al Harrington.
notes: Atlanta signed Jackson (six years, $38.25M per ShamSports; reported $38M-$44M) and traded him.

trades.bbr_text: The Denver Nuggets traded a 2005 1st round draft pick (Joey Graham was later selected), a 2006 1st round draft pick (Renaldo Balkman was later selected) and a 2006 1st round draft pick (Marcus Williams was later selected) to the New Jersey Nets for Kenyon Martin.
notes: New Jersey signed Martin and traded him (ShamSports: seven years, $91M; ESPN/Spears: seven years, $92.5M).

trades.bbr_text: The Golden State Warriors traded Nick Van Exel to the Portland Trail Blazers for Dale Davis and Dan Dickau.
The Cleveland Cavaliers traded Kedrick Brown and Kevin Ollie to the Philadelphia 76ers for Eric Snow.

The Cleveland Cavaliers traded Tony Battie, a 2005 2nd round draft pick (Martynas Andriuškevičius was later selected) and a 2007 2nd round draft pick (Brad Newley was later selected) to the Orlando Magic for Drew Gooden, Steven Hunter and Anderson Varejão.
notes: ShamSports: Orlando signed Hunter (partially guaranteed three years, $3.2M) and traded him; Cleveland waived him Aug 10.

trades.bbr_text: The Dallas Mavericks traded Danny Fortson to the Seattle SuperSonics for Calvin Booth.
The Los Angeles Clippers traded a 2005 2nd round draft pick (Chris Taft was later selected) to the New Jersey Nets for Kerry Kittles.
The Detroit Pistons traded Corliss Williamson to the Philadelphia 76ers for Derrick Coleman and Amal McCaskill.

The Atlanta Hawks traded Alan Henderson, Jason Terry and a 2007 1st round draft pick to the Dallas Mavericks for Tony Delk and Antoine Walker. Conditional 2007 1st-rd pick did not convey, DAL received cash instead
The Chicago Bulls traded Jamal Crawford and Jerome Williams to the New York Knicks for Othella Harrington, Dikembe Mutombo, Cezary Trybański and Frank Williams.
notes: Chicago signed Crawford (seven years, $55.44M per ShamSports) and traded him.

trades.bbr_text: The Boston Celtics traded Chucky Atkins, Jumaine Jones and Chris Mihm to the Los Angeles Lakers for Rick Fox, Gary Payton and a 2006 1st round draft pick (Rajon Rondo was later selected).
notes: ShamSports: Boston signed Mihm (three years, $11,378,451) and traded him; BBR does not mark it as a sign-and-trade.

trades.bbr_text: The Atlanta Hawks traded a 2005 2nd round draft pick (Ronny Turiaf was later selected) to the Charlotte Bobcats for Predrag Drobnjak.

The Dallas Mavericks traded Luis Flores, Christian Laettner, Eduardo Nájera, Mladen Sekularac, cash, a 2007 1st round draft pick (Petteri Koponen was later selected) and a future 1st round draft pick to the Golden State Warriors for Erick Dampier, Dan Dickau, Evan Eschmeyer and Steve Logan. Golden State also received a trade exception from Dallas.
notes: Golden State signed Dampier (seven years, $73M per AP) and traded him; Golden State also received a trade exception.

trades.bbr_text: The Chicago Bulls traded Dikembe Mutombo to the Houston Rockets for Adrian Griffin, Eric Piatkowski and Mike Wilks.
notes: Houston re-signed Wilks Sept 7 as a sign-and-trade (agent, AP).

trades.bbr_text: The Charlotte Bobcats traded Brandon Hunter to the Orlando Magic for Keith Bogans.

research.usage: World data (option D), research draft: real 2004 free agents by rights-holding club on June 30, 2004, and the real July 1 - November 2, 2004 signings, offer sheets, matches, sign-and-trades, rookie signings, trades and waivers. Rows with involves_miami or real_miami_player are real Miami facts, which the simulation skips (rule 1); they are kept as the alternatives simulated Miami competes against. No row may be read by Miami's front office before its date. No 2004-05 game results are included.

status_legend.derived: computed or inferred from sourced facts; the reasoning is given in the row
status_legend.unverified: could not be confirmed; value null or left as reported with a note

sources.use: ESPN.com "2004 NBA free agents", June 29, 2004, updated July 7: the team-by-team restricted/unrestricted/other list. Primary source for free_agent_rights.
All dated signings (excluding same-club re-signings), trades and waivers July 2004 - June 2005; read for 2004-07-01 to 2004-11-02.
Free-agency table (includes re-signings, offer-sheet matches), draft-pick signing dates, undrafted signings. Secondary; contains errors (e.g. Hoiberg listed as from Chicago).
Per-player contract histories: option decisions, signing dates, years and totals. Found with 2004 entries for about 90 players; many older pages are incomplete.
2004-05 salaries (rosters of 2004-12-20): first-year salary of contracts signed in the window. Later list used only to read an existing contract term.
bbr_id verification, birth dates (data-birth), seasons with games.
Period news (AP, ESPN Insider) for terms, re-signings and option decisions; index https://www.espn.com/nba/feature/featureStory?page=nbafreeagency04

signings_kind_legend.signing: free agent signs with a club other than the one holding his rights (or with no rights holder)
signings_kind_legend.re_sign: free agent signs with the club holding his rights
signings_kind_legend.offer_sheet: restricted free agent signs another club's offer sheet (from = rights holder, to = offering club)
signings_kind_legend.match: rights holder matches the offer sheet (from = to = rights holder)
signings_kind_legend.match_declined: rights holder declines to match; player joins the offering club (from = rights holder, to = offering club)
signings_kind_legend.sign_and_trade: rights holder signs the player and trades him the same day (from = signing club, to = acquiring club); the trade is also under trades
signings_kind_legend.qualifying_offer_accepted: restricted free agent signs his one-year qualifying offer
signings_kind_legend.rookie_signing: 2004 draft pick signs his first contract
signings_kind_legend.undrafted_rookie_signing: player who went undrafted in 2004 signs
